name: Giant Scorpion
location: Alik'r Desert, Ancestor Landing, Dawnmead, Salas En, Tu'whacca's Throne

abilities.name: Pincer
abilities.description: The giant scorpion attacks with a pincer, dealing minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.description: The giant scorpion attacks with its tail, dealing minor physical damage on hit then minor poison damage over 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Blurred Strike
abilities.description: The giant scorpion attacks twice with its pincers, dealing low physical damage with each strike. This can be blocked to set the giant scorpion off-balance.

abilities.name: Paralyze
abilities.description: The giant scorpion channels an attack with its tail before striking with it, dealing low physical damage and snaring for 8 seconds. This can be interrupted to set the giant scorpion off-balance. Blocking prevents the snare.

abilities.name: Hardened Carapace
abilities.description: The giant scorpion glows slightly, reducing its damage taken.

notes: The same applies for giant scorpions summoned by spriggans.
Giant Scorpions found within the Nilata Ruins, Craglorn, Hew's Bane, and Northern Elsweyr are also simply named "Scorpion".
related_quests: Burdensome Beasts: Daedric creatures from Plokun's menagerie run wild across Blackwood.
Fires of Battle: Compete in a fiery arena to claim the Brimstone Crown.
A Marriage in Ruins: Find out what happened to a mage and her sister.
Morwha's Curse: Help the Ash'abah concoct a poison antidote.
Pledge: Blessed Crucible: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Blessed Crucible.
summary: Giant Scorpions are large predatory arthropods commonly found in the arid regions of Tamriel.
